answer: Before it may vote or grade, a new agent locks a 30-hour non-cancellable spendable bond at a mesa registry and reveals a hardware-attestation nullifier. The registry appends that nullifier to a public spiral Merkle accumulator keyed by the last finalized checkpoint. Any later attempt to forge a second admission with the same quote fails the membership check immediately and burns the bond, so operator flocks cannot buy extra votes without unique hardware and a separate slashable lock for each body.
